description: Stock price and quote for any ticker or company name: last price, change and percent, previous close, day high and low, volume, 52-week high and low, currency, exchange and market time. Works for US and world stocks, ETFs, indices (^GSPC), currencies (EURUSD=X) and crypto pairs (BTC-USD). Use to price a stock in an agent, check a move, or value a portfolio line. Example: symbol=AAPL. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
